findings.evidence: Repo convention states every def's defining equation publicly with `(rfl)`: `wordFiltration_eq_pow ... := (rfl)` (TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration.lean:59), `filtrationGradedOne_def` (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/AssociatedGraded.lean:201). `pbwMonomial` has none, and the file itself must unfold it (`rw [pbwMonomial]`, lines 121, 130).
findings.fix: Add `theorem pbwMonomial_def (e : ιIndex → L) (word : List ιIndex) : pbwMonomial R L e word = ((word.map e).map ⇑ι).prod := (rfl)` and use it for the internal `rw [pbwMonomial]` steps at lines 121 and 130.
findings.issue: `pbwMonomial` is a public `def` whose body is not exposed (no `@[expose]`), and no defining equation is stated. Only `_nil`/`_cons`/`_append` are given, so nothing publicly connects `pbwMonomial R L e word` to `((word.map e).map ⇑ι).prod`. A consumer holding `prod_map_ι_mem_pbwFiltration`, `prod_map_ι_sub_prod_map_ι_mem_pbwFiltrationPrevious_of_perm`, or `pbwFiltration_le_iff` (all phrased with `(l.map ⇑ι).prod`, Filtration.lean:104,112) must re-derive the bridge by list induction.

findings.evidence: Its only use is line 89, `| swap x y l => exact prod_map_ι_sub_swap_mem_pbwFiltrationPrevious R L y x l`, i.e. exactly the `List.Perm.swap` constructor case.
findings.fix: Mark it `private`. Consumers wanting the adjacent case write `prod_map_ι_sub_prod_map_ι_mem_pbwFiltrationPrevious_of_perm R L (List.Perm.swap ..)`.
findings.issue: `prod_map_ι_sub_swap_mem_pbwFiltrationPrevious` is public but is a strictly weaker instance of `prod_map_ι_sub_prod_map_ι_mem_pbwFiltrationPrevious_of_perm` declared 10 lines below it: it equals that theorem applied to the `List.Perm.swap` constructor. It has no use outside the perm proof, so it duplicates the general public result.

findings.evidence: `filtration Q k := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration (ι Q) k` (Filtration.lean:116) and `filtrationPrevious Q := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltrationPrevious (ι Q)` (line 129); every other generic lemma already has a public Clifford specialization (lines 184-273). The new bridges are `private` at AssociatedGraded.lean:71 and 75, used only at lines 113-116 and 131-134.
findings.fix: Add public `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_left` and `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_right` in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean` as one-line specializations (`TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltrationPrevious_left (ι Q) hx hy`, mirroring `mul_mem_filtration` at line 238), then call them directly in `filtrationGradedPreMul_mem_ker_left/right` and delete the private `filtration_eq_wordFiltration` / `filtrationPrevious_eq_wordFiltrationPrevious` bridges.
findings.issue: The PR factors `mul_mem_wordFiltrationPrevious_left/right` into the shared API and specializes them for the PBW filtration (Filtration.lean:157-167), but the Clifford filtration gets no such specialization: `TauCeti.CliffordAlgebra.filtrationPrevious` publicly offers only `_zero`/`_succ`, so no consumer of the Clifford filtration can multiply modulo lower degree. AssociatedGraded.lean instead reaches the fact through two `private` bridge lemmas plus four rewrites at each use site.

findings.evidence: Mathlib supplies only `LieHom.map_lie` on `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι` (Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping.lean:79-86), whose bracket on `U(L)` is available only under the local instance at line 76; no associative-form restatement exists in Mathlib or this repo.
findings.fix: Expose `theorem ι_mul_ι_sub_ι_mul_ι (x y : L) : ι x * ι y - ι y * ι x = ι ⁅x, y⁆ := by rw [← LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, ← LieHom.map_lie]` and use it in `prod_map_ι_sub_swap_mem_pbwFiltrationPrevious`.
findings.issue: The commutator identity the module docstring headlines (`ι(x) * ι(y) - ι(y) * ι(x) = ι([x,y])`, lines 19-23) and that the PR description claims the module "supplies" is not a declaration; it is inlined as `rw [← LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, ← LieHom.map_lie]`. Every downstream PBW consumer needs it and must re-enable `attribute [local instance 100] LieRing.ofAssociativeRing` to reproduce it, even though the statement itself is purely associative.

summary: The new `pbwMonomial` definition ships without its defining equation, so its public API is disconnected from the `prod_map_ι` half of the same file and from `pbwFiltration_le_iff`. Additionally an adjacent-swap helper is public although the general permutation theorem in the same file subsumes it, the headline commutator identity is only inlined in a proof, and the Clifford side keeps the new filtration-product lemmas behind private bridge declarations instead of specializing them the way the PBW file does.
